# telnyx_ai_test_agents (Data Source)

Lists ai test agents, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_test_agent`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_test_agents` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_test_agents))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_test_agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_test_agents`

Read-Only:

- `agent_name` (String) Name of the test agent.
- `assistant_id` (String) ID of the Telnyx AI assistant under test.
- `auto_update_dropoff_nodes` (Boolean)
- `auto_update_topic_nodes` (Boolean)
- `chat_assistant_id` (String) ID of the chat assistant under test, when testing text channels.
- `contact_number` (String) Contact phone number for the test agent.
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled_personalities` (List of Number) IDs of the test personalities enabled for this agent.
- `hallucination_metric_kb_files` (List of Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `inbound` (Boolean) Whether the test agent accepts inbound calls.
- `knowledge_base_files` (List of String) Knowledge-base files associated with the test agent.
- `language` (String) ISO language code the test agent converses in.
- `llm_max_tokens` (Number)
- `llm_model` (String) Model used to drive the test agent's side of the conversation.
- `llm_system_prompt` (String)
- `llm_temperature` (Number)
- `outbound_auto_call` (Boolean)
- `outbound_numbers` (List of String) Outbound numbers associated with the test agent.
- `sip_auth` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `sip_endpoint` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
